proposal.summary: The submission is an unverified tip with no technical details or testing—claims that 'servers might be vulnerable' based on secondhand hearsay.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request technical details (vulnerable product, versions, PoC or indicators) from the reporter; if none are available, perform an internal review: inventory exposed servers, ensure patching/up-to-date, check logs/IDS for related alerts, and monitor threat intelligence for the named "new attacks".

evidence_quotes.claim: Report contains no technical details or testing
evidence_quotes.quote: I do not have technical details and I have not tested anything myself, but I wanted to let you know in case it is important so you can check your systems before something happens.
a friend who works in IT told me that your company's servers might be vulnerable to the new attacks that are in the news this month.
